sn35.22:1.1: Yo bhikkhave rūpānam uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhavo || dukkhasseso uppādo rogānaṃ ṭhiti jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo || || Yo saddānaṃ || Yo gandhānaṃ || Yo rasānaṃ || Yo poṭṭhabbānaṃ || Yo dhammānam uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo dukkhasseso uppādo rogānaṃ ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo dukkhasseso uppādo rogānaṃ ṭhiti jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo || ||
sn35.22:2.1: Yo ca kho bhikkhave rūpānaṃ nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo dukkhasseso nirodho rogānaṃ nirodho vūpasamo maraṇassa atthagamo || || Yo saddānaṃ || Yo gandhānaṃ || yo rasānaṃ || Yo poṭṭhabbānaṃ || Yo dhammānaṃ nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo || dukkhasseso nirodho rogānaṃ vūpasamo jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo ti || || Yamakavaggo dutiyo || ||
sn35.22:3.0: Tassuddānaṃ || || Sambodhena duve vuttā || Assādena apare dve || No cetena dve vuttā || Abhinandena apare dve || Uppādena dve vuttā || Vaggo tena pavuccatāti || ||
